text:
Owen Michaels opened the scoring in Carolina on Nov 21, breaking a slump, as CBS Sports put it. He's an undrafted 24-year-old rookie from Western Michigan who has been in Edmonton's lineup for all 25 games.

Three goals and five points, on just one expected goal: he's been lucky in front of the net. That will cool. The bigger issue is at five on five, where Edmonton gets only 30% of the expected goals with him on, 20 points worse than without him.

His ice time has dropped to about nine and a half minutes a night recently, down more than three from earlier in the season.

Oilers Nation wrote about him alongside Taylor Hall's 1,000th game and Zach Hyman leaving the game in the Nov 21 loss. What to watch: whether the goal buys him more ice time, or whether the on-ice numbers push him out of the lineup.
